content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027. Thereafter, services will continue as per need and subject to satisfactory performance. For Psychosocial Counselor, candidates shall be engaged on a call basis as and when required.

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month: @ Rs. 500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, reckoned as on 01 July 2026. Weightage for age is reckoned from 18 years of age (0.5 mark per completed year of age, up to a maximum of 10 marks as on 01 July 2026).

rows.age_relaxation: 3 (Three) years in addition to length of service in armed forces

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubnagar District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form and instructions from the official website of Mahabubnagar District. Fill in the application form carefully and attach self-attested copies of all required certificates. Submit the filled application form in person or through Registered Post at the Government Homoeo Dispensary in the premises of Government General Hospital beside office of the Executive Engineer T.G.M.S.I.D Division, Mahabubnagar District between 12 October 2026 and 22 October 2026 (10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Medical Officer Post) Registration certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificate issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class (or residency certificate from Tahsildar/MRO in case of Private Study) PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-serviceman quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These posts are engaged on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027 under the National AYUSH Mission, and continued service depends on need and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST, and BC candidates, 3 years for ex-servicemen (in addition to service length), and 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of SSC, Intermediate, qualifying exam pass certificate, year-wise marks memos, Board of Indian Medicine registration (for medical posts), caste certificate, study certificates from 4th to 10th class (or residency certificate), PH/ex-serviceman certificates if applicable, one passport-size photograph, and an acknowledgment card.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled applications is 22 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. Where should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person or through Registered Post at the Government Homoeo Dispensary in the premises of Government General Hospital beside office of the Executive Engineer T.G.M.S.I.D Division, Mahabubnagar District.
